top_signals.title: Japan exports growth accelerates for fifth straight month, beating estimates, on robust chip shipments
top_signals.summary: Exports growth accelerated for a fifth straight month coming in at 23.2%. Economists polled by Reuters had estimated growth at 19.9%.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Ex-Meta staffer says daughter, 14, was prey on Instagram
top_signals.summary: Meta has denied wrongdoing, saying it has continuously improved tools to protect kids and calling the states' proposed penalties "outlandish."
